changeHypothesis.summary: European renewable penetration and increasing negative-price episodes are raising the value of grid flexibility and battery storage. Storage deployment can therefore grow faster than the modest whole-company earnings growth embedded in pre-cutoff expectations for a global ESS supplier with verified European projects.
valueChain: battery storage project economics and deployment
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: IEA documented a multi-year rise in negative pricing and flexibility needs, while Reuters described a European battery buildout with capacity expected to quintuple by 2030. This is structural rather than a one-day price event.
disconfirmingEvidence: Storage growth was already an established investment narrative before the cutoff.
Negative prices alone do not guarantee attractive storage returns; regulation, market design and grid rules matter.
Whole-company earnings can be diluted by slower solar/investment-development segments and working-capital/cash-flow issues.

evidenceLedger.title: Comment on European negative power prices
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Community discussion highlighted current European renewable auction/pricing economics.

evidenceLedger.title: Comment on European negative power prices
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: A second discussion item reinforced the signal around European renewable pricing and allocation.

evidenceLedger.title: Europe's renewables market powers battery storage boom
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Reuters reported European battery capacity expected to exceed 50GW by 2030, roughly quintuple current capacity, with 3.7GW added in 2024 and volatility/negative prices improving arbitrage economics.

evidenceLedger.title: Electricity 2025 - Prices
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: IEA documented rising negative wholesale-price hours in Europe and stated that negative prices signal flexibility needs and can incentivize storage and demand response.

evidenceLedger.title: Sungrow ESS Experience Day Munich
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Sungrow explicitly described energy storage as key to European grid support and transition, following a Munich event with almost 300 attendees.

evidenceLedger.title: 阳光电源股份有限公司2024年半年度报告
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Company disclosure verifies global ESS exposure including European projects, such as an 800MWh ENGIE project and a 320MW/640MWh UK SSE project.

evidenceLedger.title: 阳光电源股份有限公司2024年第三季度报告
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: 2024前三季度 revenue and profit growth were modest at the whole-company level, while operating cash flow declined sharply, providing an important counterweight to the storage growth thesis.

evidenceLedger.title: 电力设备行业动态研究：1-2月装机数据
evidenceLedger.publisher: 证券研究机构（东方财富PDF镜像）
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: The pre-cutoff table listed 阳光电源 at 68.57元, 2024E EPS 5.76, 2025E EPS 6.37 and 2025E PE 10.8x, implying only about 10.6% EPS growth in the baseline.

evidenceLedger.title: 阳光电源：光储需求旺盛，全球龙头增长确定
evidenceLedger.publisher: 东吴证券（新浪研报镜像）
evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Pre-cutoff sell-side research already recognized strong global storage demand, confirming that the thesis must be about magnitude/valuation rather than discovery of storage as a theme.

causalChain.from: more variable renewable generation and negative prices
causalChain.mechanism: Surplus renewable generation and negative-price episodes expose timing mismatch between generation and demand.
causalChain.failureMode: Grid expansion, curtailment rules or flexible thermal/demand response solve the imbalance more cheaply.

causalChain.mechanism: Storage can charge during low/negative-price periods and discharge during higher-value periods while providing grid services.
causalChain.failureMode: Market design prevents monetization or battery returns compress from competition.

causalChain.mechanism: Sungrow has verified global ESS capability and European utility-scale projects and actively markets ESS for European grid flexibility.
causalChain.failureMode: Sungrow loses share, project awards shift to competitors, or regional trade/policy barriers reduce addressable sales.

causalChain.mechanism: Faster storage growth and overseas mix can increase revenue/profit contribution, but other segments and working-capital effects can offset the benefit.
causalChain.failureMode: Solar/investment-development weakness, margin pressure, receivables or cash-flow drag offset storage growth.

directWinners: PCS/inverter and system integrators with European utility-scale exposure
losers: inflexible generation exposed to curtailment/negative prices
falseThemeMatches: storage-themed companies without verified European projects, bankable products or meaningful revenue exposure

aShareCandidates.name: 阳光电源
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: 2024H1 disclosure verifies material global ESS activity and named European utility-scale projects; March 2025 company communication directly addresses European storage/grid flexibility.

earningsSensitivity.base: Pre-cutoff baseline EPS rose from 5.76 (2024E) to 6.37 (2025E), only ~10.6%, while storage was already expected to grow strongly.
earningsSensitivity.favorable: European and global ESS growth/mix exceeds the modest whole-company baseline and high-margin overseas storage contributes more than expected.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: Storage competition/margins, project timing, solar weakness or working-capital drag offset shipment growth.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Storage growth was already known, but a 2025-03-20 pre-cutoff table showed 阳光电源 2025E EPS of 6.37 versus 5.76 for 2024E, roughly +10.6%, with a 2025E PE around 10.8x. A 2025-03-25 report was already positive on global storage demand.
expectations.thesisExpectation: If European/global storage deployment and overseas mix are structurally stronger than the modest whole-company earnings baseline, storage can drive earnings above the low-teens growth expectation despite weakness elsewhere.
expectations.measurableGap: The gap is between high structural ESS growth evidence and a low whole-company forward multiple / modest EPS growth baseline, not between public awareness and ignorance of the storage theme.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: A dated 2025-03-20 research table used a 68.57元 reference price and ~10.8x 2025E PE for 阳光电源.
valuationExecution.alreadyPricedAssessment: partially_priced: storage growth was consensus, but the modest whole-company EPS growth assumption and low forward multiple leave a testable magnitude/mix gap.
constraints: Exact 2025-03-31 close and next executable open are intentionally withheld until the frozen lock exists.
Daily execution constraints will be evaluated after freeze.

bearCase: The apparent valuation gap may simply reflect correctly priced cyclicality, policy/trade risk, competition and cash-flow concerns. Storage growth could be strong without producing superior whole-company earnings or stock returns.

invalidationConditions.indicator: European/global battery deployment or project economics deteriorate materially.
invalidationConditions.observationMethod: Post-lock industry data and official project/market updates.
invalidationConditions.threshold: clear reversal of storage additions/order activity or economics inconsistent with the structural-growth thesis

invalidationConditions.indicator: 阳光电源 storage growth fails to improve whole-company earnings quality.
invalidationConditions.threshold: storage shipment/revenue growth accompanied by persistent margin deterioration or offsets large enough that whole-company earnings fail to exceed the modest pre-cutoff baseline

unknowns: Exact storage segment earnings contribution at cutoff
